d_and_a.source: not found: D&A null in deskstack ESEF data for all three years; not filled from memory

capex.source: not found: capex null in deskstack ESEF data for all three years; not filled from memory

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 1.3% (44,052 vs 43,487), FY2024 5.6%; assume recovery to mid-single digit then fade toward terminal growth, in line with beauty-market growth

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: filed EBIT margin 18.7% FY2023, 19.0% FY2024, 19.0% FY2025 (operating income / revenue from ESEF); hold at 19%

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. French statutory corporate rate (~25%); filed pretax/tax lines not available in tool data; Damodaran Europe Household Products effective rate 14.7% judged too low

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption/placeholder: D&A not found in filed data; set equal to capex % so net effect on FCF is neutral; reviewer should replace from the annual report cash flow statement

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption/placeholder: capex not found in filed data; set equal to D&A %; reviewer should replace from the annual report

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA, 2026-11-05) + relevered beta 0.79 (Damodaran Europe Household Products unlevered cash-corrected 0.711, D/E 0.144, tax 25%) x France ERP 5.006% = Ke ~7.2%; Kd after-tax 4.1% (Damodaran), weights 87/13 gives ~6.8%; rounded to 7.0%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro area inflation/nominal growth, below the 3.27% risk-free rate. Note: terminal value is ~79% of EV, typical for a stable, high-quality consumer franchise with a 5-year horizon; reviewer should treat the result as sensitive to WACC and g

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = borrowings_noncurrent 8,069.7 + current 2,048.9 - cash 9,865.0 (ESEF 529900JI1GG6F7RKVI53-2025-12-31-ESEF-FR-0); excludes leases

diluted_shares.source: not found: weighted diluted shares are not reported in the deskstack ESEF data (FY2025 diluted EPS 11.44 and net income to owners 6,127.2m are filed, implying ~535.6m, but that is an unfiled derivation; reviewer to take the figure from the annual report EPS note)
